_provenance: Shape: OpenAPI firewalls/models/firewall.yml and firewall_rule.yml (spec): id (uuid), status (waiting|succeeded|failed), created_at, pending_changes [{droplet_id, removing, status}], name, inbound_rules [{protocol, ports, action, sources}], outbound_rules [{protocol, ports, action, destinations}], droplet_ids, tags. A rule's targets are {addresses, droplet_ids, load_balancer_uids, kubernetes_ids, tags}; ports is "n", "a-b" or "0" (all; ICMP always "0"); action is allow (default) or deny (research S3). Values are illustrative. The emulator spreads this template and overrides id, name, status, created_at, rules, droplet_ids, tags and pending_changes.
